summary: Tested trial balance end-to-end (API + UI): module card visibility, /api/trial-balance aggregation, banking manual expense auto-journal reflection, filters, page KPIs/table/export, and module disable route-guard behavior. Most flows passed; account_type filter has a backend logic bug and auth CORS preflight remains misconfigured at public edge.

critical.issue: Account-type filter leaks non-expense rows. Observed account types: ['asset','expense'] under expense-only filter; report can incorrectly remain متوازن.
Preflight returns access-control-allow-origin='*' and lacks access-control-allow-credentials=true on public endpoint, conflicting with credentialed auth posture.

integration_issues.issue: Selecting مصروفات (expense) still shows balanced status with mixed account classes due backend filter leakage.

action_items: Fix /api/trial-balance account_type filtering to exclude journal-derived rows outside selected account class.
Recheck row construction path in get_trial_balance: when account_type is set, prevent fallback insertion of unmatched lines with non-target account_type.
Fix edge/ingress preflight headers for auth to return explicit allowed origin and allow-credentials=true.
critical_code_review_comments: Root cause for account-type filter bug: account query is filtered, but unmatched journal lines are still added later via fallback row creation (key not in rows_by_key path), bypassing account_type restriction.
backend/server.py is still a large monolith (>3900 LOC), increasing regression risk in accounting-sensitive logic changes.
Official Egyptian Tax Authority e-invoice submission remains MOCKED/internal and was not validated against a live external authority endpoint.
test_credentials: Read /app/memory/test_credentials.md and used admin_takaful/Admin@123 on social-solidarity for backend and UI checks.
seed_data_creation: Created trial-balance UI seed movement via banking manual charges (industrial-development, 2101/11, total 100).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Module trial_balance was restored to enabled at end of UI run. Stable seed exists at 2101-11 for social-solidarity. Repro for bug: call /api/trial-balance with from_date=2101-11-01, to_date=2101-11-30, account_type=expense, non_zero_only=true; API still returns asset row.
rca of the issue: RCA: In get_trial_balance, accounts are pre-filtered by account_type, but journal line processing later adds rows for keys not present in rows_by_key using account/code/name fallback. This path reintroduces non-target account classes (e.g., asset bank row) even when account_type=expense. Mitigation: skip fallback row insertion when account_type filter is active and resolved/fallback account_type does not match filter.
